correction.text: Valona, Kanina and Berat, 1346-1351 only: 'roughly encompassing the territories of the modern counties of Vlorë (Valona), Fier, and Berat'; replaces the 773.5 km2 patch

keyframe_review.note: 773.5 km2 for 1333-1351. The principality begins in 1346, not 1333: Valona was Byzantine from about 1290 'into the 1340s' and fell to Dušan in late 1345 or early 1346 (infobox 'Serbian conquest: 1346'; some scholars say 1337). The page gives no area; the three counties it names measure about 5,058 km2 by the gazetteer (20 cells: Vlorë about 2,276, Berat about 1,264, Fier the rest). Cliopatria's 1333-1374 patch is 773.5 km2 and its 1395 shape ('Principality of Valona and Kanina', 6,060 km2, bbox 19.70-21.21 E, 39.97-40.87 N) lies east of Vlorë (19.49 E), Kanina (19.52 E) and Fier (19.56 E) and so leaves out the capital; the corrections are therefore drawn from the counties, not from Cliopatria's outline (repair of 2026-10-25).

correction.text: Vlorë county: Balsha II 'was granted control of Vlorë and Kaninë as part of her dowry' in 1372; the lordship 'confined to the area around Vlorë, with Kaninë, Himarë and the fort of Pyrgos'

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe for 1372-1394 (Cliopatria's 1363 shape ends in 1374 and leaves 1375-1394 empty). 1372: Balsha II marries Comita Muzaka and receives Vlorë and Kanina as her dowry (main text; footnote 15, quoting Djukanović, has 'Valona, Berat, and Kanina', the sources conflict); 'Berat however had already fallen to the Muzaka', and after Savra (1385) the lordship was 'confined to the area around Vlorë, with Kaninë, Himarë and the fort of Pyrgos'. Venice refused offers of Valona in 1386, 1393 and 1395. Vlorë county measures about 2,276 km2 by the gazetteer, against 5,058 km2 for the three counties: the principality shrank to about 45 percent of its first extent (Cliopatria draws 6,060 km2 for 1395-1417, a factor of 2.7 too large and in the wrong place).

6,060 km2 for 1395-1414 in Cliopatria, whose outline (bbox 19.70-21.21 E) lies east of Vlorë and Kanina and leaves out the capital. The page's extent after 1372 is the area around Vlorë with Kanina, Himarë and Pyrgos (Vlorë county, about 2,276 km2 by the gazetteer, ratio 2.7 to Cliopatria's Area; the infobox's three counties, about 5,058 km2, are the pre-1372 extent). Comita Muzaka and Rugina ruled to 1396, then Mrkša Žarković (1396-1414). The row is one state with the earlier Valona row (same Wikipedia article and Wikidata Q7245121).

region.text: Valona with Kanina and Berat (infobox: 'Serbian conquest: 1346'; 'roughly encompassing the territories of the modern counties of Vlorë (Valona), Fier, and Berat')

ledger.note: 1346: Dušan's vassal John Komnenos Asen takes Valona. 'Valona fell in late 1345 or early 1346'; 'Dušan placed his brother-in-law John Komnenos Asen in charge, with Valona as capital and Kanina and Berat as main fortresses' and made him a Despot; Dušan's vassal until 1355, then independent under strong Venetian influence.

1372: the house of Balsha takes Valona. 'In 1372 Balsha II married Comita Muzaka and received Valona and Kanina as her dowry'; the page says it is unclear whether Muzaka had already taken the cities. Same state, new ruling house (rule 2). The same page says Berat 'had already fallen to the Muzaka' and that the lordship was 'confined to the area around Vlorë'; see the two losses that follow.

region.text: Berat, held with Kanina by John Komnenos Asen, which 'had already fallen to the Muzaka'

ledger.note: By 1372: Berat passes to the Muzaka. The page has 'Berat however had already fallen to the Muzaka' (in the account of Savra, 1385) and gives Balsha II only 'Vlorë and Kaninë' as Comita's dowry in 1372; a footnote quoting a Montenegrin dictionary (Djukanović) has the dowry as 'Valona, Berat, and Kanina', so the sources conflict and the date is the page's 1372 dowry list, not a dated loss. The counterpart is the Muzaka lordship of Berat, which has no Cliopatria row of its own before the Albanian Principalities row of 1375.

region.text: Fier, outside the lordship 'confined to the area around Vlorë'

ledger.note: By 1372: Fier leaves the principality. The page names Fier only in the extent of the three counties; it says the lordship 'was now confined to the area around Vlorë, with Kaninë, Himarë and the fort of Pyrgos' and does not say who held Fier or when it was lost, so this event is a bridge between the three counties of 1346 and the area around Vlorë of 1385 (confidence 1) and the holder is the Albanian lords in general.
1385: the Muzaka rule. Balsha II was killed at the Battle of Savra in 1385 and Comita Muzaka ruled 1385-1396 jointly with her daughter Rugina.
1396: Mrkša Žarković becomes lord of Valona and Kanina (1396-1414); Italian sources call him 'King of Serbia'.
1414: Rugjina Balsha rules the principality (1414-1417), the last ruler.

region.text: the principality's last extent, the area around Vlorë

ledger.note: 1417: the Ottomans take Valona. 'The Ottomans took the city in 1417' after Venice had refused to buy the principality in 1386, 1393 and 1395; it becomes the Sanjak of Avlona.

wars.name: Serbian conquest of Valona

zones.text: Valona, Kanina and Berat ('roughly encompassing the territories of the modern counties of Vlorë (Valona), Fier, and Berat')

wars.outcome: Dušan took Albania during the Byzantine civil war; Valona fell in late 1345 or early 1346 and John Komnenos Asen was put in charge (some scholars: Valona and Kanina already in 1337).

wars.name: Ottoman conquest of Valona
wars.outcome: The Ottomans took the city in 1417; Venice's attempts to recover or buy the territory came to nothing.
wars.note: The Ottoman victory at Kosovo (1389) had made the principality's position worse; Balsha II fell at Savra in 1385.

certainty.note: The page names the extent as counties and gives no boundaries; the shape is the three counties (1346-1371) and Vlorë county (1372-1417), read from the gazetteer, not a surveyed line.

sources.title: Principality of Valona
sources.note: The single article for the whole 1346-1417 state: Serbian conquest 1346, independence 1355, the six rulers with years, Balsha 1372, Ottoman conquest 1417; no area figure.

notes: MERGE TEST (shares Q7245121 with principality-of-valona-and-kanina): MERGED. Both Cliopatria rows cite the same Wikipedia article 'Principality of Valona', which is one state 1346-1417 with a single list of six rulers; the 1375-1394 gap in Cliopatria is bridged by the new keyframe. This dossier lists both Names in cliopatria_names and reviews both rows' shapes; the eu-18 part that was to write principality-of-valona-and-kanina should skip it (it would double-review the same shapes). Cliopatria's 1333-1374 shapes are wrong by size (773 km2 against the 5,058 km2 of the three counties the page names) and by start (1333 against 1346): the principality begins with the Serbian conquest. The Valona patch matches the 725-773 km2 coastal patch Cliopatria gives the House of Anjou-Sicily in 1294-1325, which is the Angevin coast and not this state. Not on the page: any border, the land of Berat's Muzaka lords against Valona (Comita Muzaka's dowry gave Balsha only 'Valona and Kanina'), Valona under the Serbian Empire as a dated vassal state (recorded as vassal events in the serbian-empire ledger, which cites this page), and the relation to the Despotate of Epirus (John 'styled himself heir to the Despots of Epirus'). Gazetteer names needed: Kanina (a place, near Vlorë), none else. Repairs of 2026-10-25 (review eu-18-d): every correction is now drawn from the gazetteer counties and not from Cliopatria's 'Principality of Valona and Kanina' 1395 outline, which lies east of Vlorë and Kanina (bbox 19.70-21.21 E; Vlorë 19.49 E) and so leaves out the capital; the three counties (about 5,058 km2) hold for 1346-1371 and Vlorë county (about 2,276 km2) for 1372-1417, because the page says Berat 'had already fallen to the Muzaka' and the lordship was 'confined to the area around Vlorë, with Kaninë, Himarë and the fort of Pyrgos'. The page's own sources conflict on Berat (main text: dowry of 1372 = Vlorë and Kaninë; footnote 15, Djukanović: Valona, Berat and Kanina), recorded as a loss of Berat by 1372 at confidence 2 and of Fier at confidence 1 (page silent on Fier). The Muzaka lordship of Berat has no Cliopatria row (the Albanian Principalities row starts in 1375) and is entered under albanian-principalities; its owner (eu-18) should confirm. The new keyframe principality-of-valona_1372 replaces the earlier _1375.
